description: bulk_redirects.getRedirects (GET /v1/bulk-redirects): the 200 response is a oneOf whose first branch is a bare map `{type: object}`, degrading the whole union to unknown. Collapse to the full branch (version + redirects + pagination), then reconcile with live behavior probed 2026-08-13: a project with no redirects history returns `{redirects: [], version: null}` with NO pagination — mark version nullable and relax required to redirects only.
